category: newly launched institutional repository (InvenioRDM 14, KTH Royal Institute of Technology)

free_tier.stated: 50 GB and 100 files per record by default; 10 GB per file. Quota increase is granted on email request to researchdata@kth.se. Not a hard wall — a record with a 70.4 GB single object exists in the public API, i.e. increases are real and granted.

egress.terms: Free and anonymous. Downloads 302 to presigned.s3.cloud.kth.se with X-Amz-Expires=60 — sixty seconds, so rule 8 applies hard: re-resolve per request or watch every parallel GET return an empty 302.

chaining: Mountable via any InvenioRDM wrapper; the 60-second presign makes it a poor CDN origin unless fronted by Cloudflare with a re-resolving shim.
limits_note: 100 files per record by default. 'For data governance reasons ... all data must belong to at least one community.' Files immutable after publication; one-month grace period.
reliability_note: Login is ORCID / GitHub / KTH SSO — genuinely open — but deposit requires membership of a KTH community, and the quota-increase email asks which 'organisation, project, or grant' the data belongs to.

evidence.proved: 58 records; largest file 70,402,901,125 bytes (sensor_data.zip), then 11.86 GB and 10.89 GB
